confirmed_facts_tz: Product name: ContentForge. TZ version 1.1 dated 2026-08-17.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, React Vite+TypeScript, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2.x, Alembic, Celery, Redis, OpenAI API.
Channels in scope: instagram, vk, telegram, wordpress, gmail. Mailchimp is out of scope (TZ v1.1).
MVP autopost: Telegram + WordPress. Gmail: SMTP App Password + own recipients, fallback manual_copy. VK: card + manual_copy. Instagram: review/manual_copy, not critical path.
PostgreSQL is source of truth for slots and Publication. Redis is broker/cache only. Beat scans DB every minute.
AI generate and publish must not run in request thread. Generate plan returns HTTP 202.
Channel tokens encrypted at rest (TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Never returned to client.
Gmail is transport not ESP: recipients in EmailRecipient; metrics sent/failed only; cap 50 per publication; ~500/day Google consumer limit.
A/B social: sequential. Gmail: gmail_split_list if >=2 recipients.
Acceptance IDs AC-01..AC-23 exist in TZ §18.
Default TZ §19: manual trends, local media, IG single image later, Viewer in phase 2, erid reminder only, one WP site per ChannelAccount, Gmail SMTP+App Password.
UI language Russian. Content locale ru|en on brand and piece.
Roles: Owner, Editor, Analyst, Viewer. MVP may collapse to Owner+Editor.
Plan statuses: generating|draft|approved|archived. Failed AI job must not persist a partial plan.
Repo layout in TZ appendix C: backend/, frontend/, docker-compose.yml, .env.example.
